title: Ravin Chasida
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Kiddushin 59a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.59a.4): he went to betroth a woman for his son, and in the end betrothed her for himself.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=184&lang=en) agree on who was sent to arrange the betrothal and whom he ultimately betrothed. The Gemara then asks about his conduct and supplies the circumstances. Hyman gives the short form of the story.
